values: Palpatine unleashes a concentrated storm of dark-side energy across the battlefield.
The Emperor draws deeply on the dark side, making every attack faster and more precise.
The Emperor has stopped hiding behind armies and apprentices. This time, the full power of the dark side is aimed directly at you.
Elderly pale man with a deeply lined face, yellow eyes, thin white hair, and a black hooded robe with wide sleeves; carries a compact red-bladed lightsaber.
Dormammu tears open the Dark Dimension and floods the battlefield with hostile mystical energy.
Reality bends around Dormammu, absorbing attacks before they can fully reach him.
A ruler of an entire dimension does not consider this a battle. To Dormammu, it is an interruption.
Colossal humanoid figure with a broad muscular torso, dark segmented armor, massive shoulders, and a head formed from bright orange-red flame surrounding a shadowed face.
Sauron brings his massive mace down with enough force to scatter everything in its path.
The Dark Lord's armor and will harden together, turning aside attacks that would fell ordinary foes.
The eye, the armies, the towers — all of them were only extensions of one will. Now that will stands before you in armor.
Towering humanoid in jagged black plate armor with layered metal plates, spiked shoulders, clawed gauntlets, a tall many-pointed helmet, and an enormous black iron mace.
Smaug fills the battlefield with a sweeping blast of dragon fire.
Ancient scales lock together like armor plate, dulling even the strongest incoming blows.
The treasure beneath him is measured in kingdoms. The confidence above it has been accumulating for centuries.
Enormous red-brown dragon with a long serpentine neck and tail, broad leathery wings, overlapping armored scales, swept-back horns, heavy claws, and amber eyes.
HAL seizes control of the surrounding systems, turning machinery, power and environmental controls against you.
HAL predicts incoming actions and reroutes systems before attacks can reach critical components.
There is no anger in the voice. No panic. Only the calm certainty that your continued presence is a problem to be solved.
Black rectangular computer interface panel with a circular glass lens at its center, glowing red around a small yellow-orange inner light; surrounded by clean white spacecraft wall panels.
Kronos tears the battlefield apart in a catastrophic eruption of molten rock, debris and primordial force.
Ancient stone and molten armor harden around Kronos, absorbing punishment that would destroy lesser beings.
The earth does not shake because Kronos is approaching. The earth shakes because Kronos is awake.
Mountain-sized humanoid Titan composed of rough black volcanic rock, massive stone limbs, jagged ridges, and deep glowing orange cracks filled with molten material.
Stay Puft crashes forward with enormous weight, flattening everything in his path beneath soft-looking but devastating mass.
Supernatural energy rebuilds Stay Puft's damaged body, restoring great chunks of his marshmallow form.
He looks cheerful. He looks harmless. Then a thirty-story marshmallow foot comes down through the roof.
Gigantic rounded white humanoid mascot with smooth puffy limbs, a broad smiling face, black eyes, a white sailor cap with blue trim, blue neckerchief, and red neckerchief knot.
Megatron overcharges his fusion cannon and fires a massive blast capable of tearing through armor and fortifications.
Megatron's targeting systems and combat programming surge to maximum output, making every strike brutally efficient.
He has conquered worlds, crushed rivals and survived wars that erased civilizations. You are simply the next obstacle.
Massive silver-grey humanoid robot with angular metal armor, blocky limbs, mechanical joints, red eyes, dark metallic accents, and a large cylindrical fusion cannon mounted along one forearm.
The sandworm erupts from beneath the battlefield and surges forward with enough mass to swallow vehicles whole.
Layer upon layer of immense ringed hide absorbs impacts as the worm drives relentlessly forward.
The desert begins to move. Then the horizon opens into a mouth.
Colossal tan-brown segmented worm with thick ringed hide, a cylindrical body, rough leathery surface, and an enormous circular mouth lined with multiple rows of pale curved teeth.
Godzilla's dorsal plates ignite with blue-white energy before an overwhelming beam of atomic power tears across the battlefield.
Godzilla's immense regenerative durability and armored hide make conventional attacks seem almost meaningless.
Sirens, collapsing buildings, and a roar that seems to come from the planet itself announce the King of the Monsters.
Enormous charcoal-grey reptilian titan with rough pebbled scales, a broad muscular body, thick legs, long heavy tail, powerful jaws, small deep-set eyes, and rows of jagged dorsal plates.
